source_preservation_rule: AI-NEW ID, source name, source structural level and AI-CAP lineage are immutable inputs. Structural decomposition adds runtime metadata only.
composite_rule: A composite candidate remains one approved source record. Runtime decomposition is required only when listed components have separate activation, verification or closure conditions; otherwise the source record may execute as one bounded mechanism.

ownership_derivation.MECHANISM: AI_PRIMARY unless an existing ASI segment/interface is present, then AI_PRIMARY_WITH_ASI_GOVERNANCE_INTERFACE
ownership_derivation.CONTROL: SHARED_AI_ASI_CONTROL when an ASI interface is present; otherwise AI_LOCAL_CONTROL_WITHOUT_PERMISSION_AUTHORITY
ownership_derivation.FILTER: AI_FILTER_WITH_ASI_ACCEPTANCE_INTERFACE when an ASI interface is present; otherwise AI_LOCAL_FILTER
ownership_derivation.STATE: AI_RUNTIME_STATE_UNDER_ASI_POLICY when an ASI interface is present; otherwise AI_RUNTIME_STATE

authority_guards: AI mechanism output is not execution authority.
AI filter output is not automatically a closure decision.
Control, master-control and state records cannot bypass ASI authority, Sequence thresholds or barriers.
Evidence-control records may update evidence/provenance state only under their write contract; they do not create source facts.
Composite candidates with independently closable components must use explicit subcontracts or Sub-Sequences rather than hidden in-place loops.
engine_binding_rule: No direct Engine ID may be generated from name similarity. Direct Engine binding requires an existing source-derived relation. Otherwise use ENGINE_BINDING_OPEN and preserve operational-element candidates separately as mapping hypotheses.

MECHANISM.closure: mechanism output produced and verified or terminal failure returned

CONTROL.closure: bounded control decision returned; permission-bearing consequences still require ASI/Sequence authority

EVIDENCE_CONTROL.closure: evidence-control update verified and ledger write accepted

META_CONTROL.closure: bounded governance result returned; no automatic parent closure

STATE.closure: state itself does not close a Sequence; consuming edge must close against its own contract

STATE_OR_MECHANISM_MIXED.activation: caller declares state-read or mechanism-execution mode
